QuestInfo.name: Mystic Gate Master
QuestInfo.0: Doctor Moon has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.1: Doctor Moon says that he'll give you the qualifications to become a Mystic Field Master if you help him stop the Mystic Field.
QuestInfo.2: Doctor Moon thanked you for helping him stop the Mystic Field, and gave you the Mystic Field Master medal.

0.0: You're already qualified to be a Mystic Field researcher. All your hard work has been a big help in defending against the Mystic Fields. Why don't you go for the Mystic Field Master title as well?
0.1: Just as you've done so far, defeat the monsters and use their Mystic Energy, this time at least 200 times. That will surely make you qualified to be a Mystic Field Master.

no.0: One must never give up on one's dreams...

1.0: Once I fully comprehend the nature of this Mystic Energy, we can put a stop to it once and for all. If only becoming a pop idol were as simple as understanding the true nature of the universe. Ah well.

default.0: Eliminate Mystic bosses, use their Mystic Energy 200 times, and I will grant you the qualifications to become a Mystic Field Master. While you didn't actually do any research, I don't mind sharing the credit.
